Name: (CP) More Buildings for Cute Valley Blue for Content Patcher
Author: BeneathThePlass
Description:
Like many others before me, I'm sure, when I found the [url=https://community.playstarbound.com/threads/content-patcher-cute-valley-1-3-beta.110882/]Cute Valley mod[/url], made by [url=https://community.playstarbound.com/members/rosalie.518048/]Rosalie [/url]on the Chucklefish forums ([i]now also posted [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3503]here on Nexus[/url][/i]), I loved it instantly. The house and stable included in the mod are adorable! I was a little sad, however, at how lackluster the rest of my farm ended up looking in comparison. I mean, how is a girl to tend to her crops when she's distracted by the lack of cuteness in her barns and coops? So, I set out to make matching textures for all the other farm buildings in pink! And now, [i]finally[/i], I've also made a matching set of buildings in blue, and thought I'd share them for others' enjoyment!

[b]Included in this mod are the following buildings, done in the blue style of Rosalie's Cute Valley mod;[/b]
[i]Barn
Big Barn
Deluxe Barn
Coop
Big Coop
Deluxe Coop
Fish Pond
Mill
Shed
Big Shed
Silo
Slime Hutch
Well
Interior for Coop/Barn
Interior for Slime Hutch- you have your choice of the vanilla hutch layout, or a slightly extended hutch layout[/i]
[i]

[/i][b]Please note that the original Cute Valley - Blue house & stable ([i]and everything else[/i]) is not included in this mod. To get the house/stable, download the original mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3503]here[/url] or [url=https://community.playstarbound.com/threads/content-patcher-cute-valley.110882/]here[/url]![/b]


This expansion pack mod uses the awesome[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915] Content Patcher[/url], by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/1552317]Pathoschild[/url], so both [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] are required for it to work.


Hey, good news folks! I've formatted More Buildings for Cute Valley Blue into a content pack for the fantastic[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915] [/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url] mod, and you can find it over [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15844/]here[/url]﻿﻿!



[b]Installation: [/b]
1. Make sure that you have both [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] correctly installed in your Stardew Valley folder.
2. Unzip the '[CP] More Buildings for Cute Valley Blue' folder and drop it into your 'Mods' folder in the main SDV game folder.
3. Congrats, you're done and ready to go! Enjoy your new farm!



[b]Credits:[/b]
[list]
[*]Massive credit, of course, to [url=https://community.playstarbound.com/members/rosalie.518048/]Rosalie [/url]﻿on the Chucklefish forums, as they created the original [url=https://community.playstarbound.com/threads/content-patcher-cute-valley-1-3-beta.110882/]Cute Valley mod[/url]﻿ and provided so much inspiration for these textures! Also, a few textures were reused from their houses texture, such as the flower baskets.
[*]The texture for the coop/barn interior floor, and the texture for the slime hutch interior wall was made by [url=https://community.playstarbound.com/members/barfyscorpion.628400/]barfyscorpion [/url]﻿on the Chucklefish forums, and can be found at [url=https://community.playstarbound.com/threads/barfys-fancy-farmhouses-and-other-addons-update-links-are-back-up.112984/]their thread there[/url]﻿- along with a host of other great textures, so go check it out!
[/list]
